name: hydroxy-delta-5-steroid dehydrogenase, 3 beta- and steroid delta-isomerase 1

function.text: HSD3B1 encodes 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase/Delta 5-->4-isomerase type 1 (3-beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid dehydrogenase). Annotated molecular activities include steroid Delta-isomerase activity and 3-beta-hydroxy-Delta5-steroid dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. It participates in androgen biosynthetic process and estrogen biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
